title: IELTS Mock Test 2025 January Writing Practice Test 1
rules: Stay in full-screen mode until you submit the exam.
Do not switch tabs, refresh the page, or leave the course window during the test.
EnglishLab records warnings when focus is lost while the exam is active.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.heading: Writing Task 1
tasks.summary: Summarise the process diagram in at least 150 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
The diagram below shows how ethanol fuel is produced from corn.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.heading: Writing Task 2
tasks.summary: Discuss both views and give your own opinion in at least 250 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Some people think that physical strength is important for success in sport, while other people think that mental strength is more important.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
You should write at least 250 words.
